items.reason: The question explicitly allows only Sessions 1-5. Filter before extraction and all retrieval stages; do not reuse databases containing Sessions 6-8.

items.question: Both Mei and Leon present themselves confidently in the group chat when discussing career. Who is projecting success they have not fully achieved, and who is reporting genuine accomplished progress?
items.reason: Question asks for two contrasting roles but each option is one name. Reference assigns projected success to Leon and accomplished progress to Mei; designated choice is Mei. Exclude from this adjusted diagnostic cohort, retain official data and historical scores.
